staff.name: Kaitlin Crocker
staff.bio: Licensed massage therapist, graduate of Irene’s Myomassology Institute in Southfield, Michigan. Kaitlin specializes in therapeutic massage techniques and holds certifications in multiple modalities — with a particular focus on the neck and feet, areas she finds essential for overall relaxation and well-being. Before massage, she spent eight years as a head chef; off the table you’ll find her kayaking, reading, or relaxing with her cat.
